knowledge.text: In the two-creditcard task val:0017, the Candidate succeeded but took 17 steps versus the Parent's 9, and the new multi-instance source-reuse priority produced no step advantage in this pair. The Candidate's first creditcard came from dresser 1, which showed only one card (Q7:5, Q7:6), so the exact 'source also shows additional instances' trigger was not met. After placing that card, it did return to a previously observed desk 1 that still held creditcards (Q7:8, Q7:14), took creditcard 2 (Q7:15), and delivered it to safe 1 (Q7:17). The un-edited Parent had already performed an immediate same-source reuse at desk 1: take creditcard 2 (P7:2), deliver it (P7:5), return to desk 1 (P7:6), take creditcard 3 (P7:7), and deliver it (P7:9). Thus source-return behavior was preserved in the Candidate, but success and the clause's adherence did not reduce steps here; the Candidate's extra actions came from earlier searching of drawer 1, drawer 2, dresser 1, and sidetable 1 (Q7:1, Q7:2, Q7:3, Q7:5, Q7:6, Q7:8) and a safe 1/desk 1/safe 1 shuttle before the first placement (Q7:9, Q7:10, Q7:11, Q7:13), not from a broad post-placement re-sweep.

In the two-book task val:0016, the joint edit was associated with a Parent-success/Candidate-failure regression: the Parent succeeded in 43 steps by reaching bed 1 (P6:5), taking book 1 (P6:6), delivering it, later returning to bed 1 (P6:39), taking book 2 (P6:40), and delivering it (P6:43), whereas the Candidate ended at the 50-step limit without acquiring any book. The Candidate repeatedly selected already-checked shelf 1, shelf 2, drawer 1, drawer 2, sidetable 1, and desk 1 (Q6:1, Q6:5, Q6:9, Q6:14, Q6:19, Q6:23, Q6:32, Q6:44, Q6:50) and never selected bed 1, although bed 1 appeared in its initial observation (Q6:1). Because the Candidate never took a first book or observed a source with a remaining book, the new two-instance source-reuse clause had no applicable opportunity here; the failure is a search-coverage/cycle problem under the joint edit, consistent with non-adherence to or insufficiency of the revised widening/stall guidance, while route choice and the Actor's short visible history limit causal attribution.

In val:0013 ('heat some apple and put it in diningtable'), both Parent and Candidate ended at the 50-step limit without the apple, so the edit produced no whole-task improvement. The Candidate repeatedly returned to countertop 1, countertop 2, fridge 1, cabinet 1, and cabinet 2 (Q3:13, Q3:15, Q3:16, Q3:17, Q3:20, Q3:30) and revisited diningtable 1 (Q3:32), while the initial observation (Q3:1) listed untried drawers 1-3 and cabinets 3-10 that never appear in its logged actions. This is consistent with the revised new-family stall-break rule not being followed or not being sufficient, but because the Actor has only the current observation and the last two pre-action pairs, inability to track checked families cannot be distinguished from non-adherence; the pair remains an unchanged double failure rather than a new regression.

In the four single-object transform pairs whose target was found—val:0011 (cool plate), val:0012 (cool tomato), val:0014 (heat tomato), and val:0015 (heat tomato)—Parent and Candidate all succeeded and delivered after the required transform. val:0014 and val:0015 followed the same transform-then-deliver sequence (P4:2, P4:5, P4:6, P4:8, P4:9 and Q4:2, Q4:5, Q4:6, Q4:8, Q4:9; P5:1, P5:2, P5:4, P5:5, P5:7, P5:8 and Q5:1, Q5:2, Q5:4, Q5:5, Q5:7, Q5:8). val:0011 differed only in the final valid countertop choice: the Parent delivered to countertop 1 (P1:6, P1:7), while the Candidate delivered to its source countertop 2 (Q1:6, Q1:7), both in 7 steps. val:0012 added one Candidate step because it opened the fridge before cooling (Q2:5, Q2:6), whereas the Parent cooled at the closed fridge (P2:5); both still succeeded. These observations show that the new multi-instance and stall clauses did not break immediate pickup or transform-then-deliver in short searches, while the open-fridge step is a local success-preserving difference not required by the new edits.
